title: Compactification tensor transpose is unital and natural
statement:
Fix the global finite-field datum and $k=\overline{\mathbf F}_q$, a prime $\ell\ne\operatorname{char}k$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, a uniformizer $\varpi_E$ and $n\ge1$, and put $A=\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^n$ [def-pur-conventions]. Let $a:X\to Y$ be a separated finite-type morphism of finite-type $k$-schemes, with no absolute separatedness assumption [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties]. On their small pro-etale sites use the bounded constructible category $D^b_c$ and its full subcategory $D^b_{ctf}$ of finite Tor amplitude [def-pur-conventions], pullback and derived tensor [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom], compact-support direct image $F=Ra_!$ and its constructible right adjoint $G=Ra^!$ with counit $\varepsilon:FG\to1$ [def-weil-exceptional-inverse-image]. Put $P=La^*$, $W=G(A_Y)$ and let $u:P(A_Y)\xrightarrow{\sim}A_X$ be the canonical coefficient-unit comparison.

Choose a compactification $a=pj$, and use exactly the proper counit-defined and open tensor factors specifying $\operatorname{PF}^c$ in [def-exchange-projection]. For $K\in D^b_{ctf}(Y,A)$ let $q_K:F(PK\otimes^LW)\to K$ be the composite
$$q_K=\lambda_K\circ(\varepsilon_{A_Y}\otimes1_K)\circ(\operatorname{PF}^c_{a,W,K})^{-1}\circ F(\mathrm{sym}_{PK,W}),$$
where $\lambda$ is the left unitor, and let $\theta_K:PK\otimes^LW\to GK$ be its $F\dashv G$ transpose, the specified map of [def-pur-co-smoothness]. Then for every $M\in D^b_c(X,A)$ the map $\operatorname{PF}^c_{a,M,A_Y}$ is the identity of $FM$ under the canonical unitors and $u$. In particular
$$\theta_{A_Y}=\lambda_W\circ(u\otimes1_W).$$
For every morphism $v:K\to L$ in $D^b_{ctf}(Y,A)$ one has
$$q_L\circ F(Pv\otimes1_W)=v\circ q_K,\qquad G(v)\circ\theta_K=\theta_L\circ(Pv\otimes1_W).$$
These assertions concern the specified compactification projection and its transpose and require no cohomological smoothness, orientation or twist.
